title: Mario's DOE clearance delays and repression of his experience
place_text: US Department of Energy (Oak Ridge, Los Alamos)

tellings.quote: I I had to repress this because my first clearance took over 8 months to obtain

plain: In 1978 a former airman named Mario Woods, who says he was abducted by aliens while in the Air Force, pushed the memory of that experience down because he was waiting on a security clearance from the US Department of Energy, the agency that runs nuclear sites such as Oak Ridge and Los Alamos. Woods tells it himself: "I had to repress this because my first clearance took over 8 months to obtain." He gives it to explain why he stayed silent for so long.
